ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels cover approximately 80% of the visible ventral surface, bounded by a continuous low-intensity black margin along the trailing and lateral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black boundary along the perimeter. A vertical black streak bisects the fluke at the central axis. Focal dark punctate spots are clustered in the mid-lateral left lobe and upper-lateral right lobe. Large amorphous tan/yellowish regions are located in the center-left and center-right lobe quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 60 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and varying indentation depths; prominent irregular jaggedness on the lateral thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave arc along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (dark outlines on white ground) detected on the distal right lobe tip and scattered across the mid-region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) radiating outward from the central peduncle area across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Encrusting organisms (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; significant irregular tissue indentations on the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellow-brown surface staining (diatom film) distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes.
